column12: Case Instructions  Please read the following instructions carefully.  You will be asked to report your beliefs about a topic. You will need to choose one position.  You must not consult any external sources, including the internet, chatbots, books, or any other reference materials.  Responses should be based solely on your existing knowledge and personal beliefs. There are no correct or incorrect answers; the objective is to capture your individual judgment.
column13: Operational Quantum Computers   The following statements are about operational quantum computers:  Statement 1: Humans have developed operational quantum computers, which use the principles of quantum physics to process information differently from traditional computers, enabling new types of calculations that are not feasible with classical machines.  Statement 2: Humans have not been able to develop operational quantum computers; which use the principles of quantum physics to process information differently from traditional computers, enabling new types of calculations that are not feasible with classical machines.
